subject: Mythology
title: Eshu: The Trickster at the Crossroads
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Eshu: The Trickster at the Crossroads.

hook.text: Eshu stands at every crossroads in life, deciding who gets blessings and who gets chaos, based on proper offerings.

buildup.text: He is the Yoruba messenger between gods and humans. No prayer reaches the Orishas without passing through Eshu first.

discovery.text: He once walked down a road wearing a hat red on one side and blue on the other, starting a fight between neighbors.

twist.text: Both neighbors were right about the hat color and wrong at the same time. Eshu taught that perspective is everything.

climax.text: Colonizers mistakenly equated Eshu with the Devil. He is not evil — he is the force that tests and teaches humanity.

punchline.text: The god who starts arguments does it to show everyone they might be wrong.

quiz.question: What role does Eshu play in Yoruba religion?
options: He is the guardian of the underworld
He is the messenger between gods and humans at life's crossroads
He is the god of war who leads armies into battle
